findings.summary: Cache the unary Math fold result before testing whether it is finite.
Use a shared UTF-16 cursor for String.at and codePointAt so indexed reads avoid decoding and allocating the entire string.
Reserve Array.concat's total result capacity after evaluating its arguments, then append into one result array.
Unwrap property receivers once and combine the repeated value-expression fallback branches.
Share numeric argument evaluation and snapshot emission between array and string methods.
Centralize callback receiver rules for identity snapshots, removed entries and fact invalidation.
Route String.concat through the existing concatenation runtime and remove the superseded Number.isFinite dispatcher.
